# pkg/gateway assembly contract (ADR-0012, frozen).
#
# One "Struct Field Type" line per exported field of Deps, Options,
# BuildOptions and RequestStats, sorted. Compared by TestOptionsContractDoc,
# which reflects over the live structs. Add, remove, rename or retype a field
# here or in code and the test fails; change the ADR first, then this golden.
#
# Format: <StructName> <FieldName> <reflect.Type.String()>

BuildOptions Allowlist []string
BuildOptions Detectors []string
BuildOptions Sink audit.AuditSink
BuildOptions Timeout time.Duration
BuildOptions Tool string

Deps DataDir string
Deps Redactions *atomic.Uint64
Deps Requests *atomic.Uint64
Deps Token string

Options Core config.Config
Options CostSink extension.CostSink
Options Mount func(*http.ServeMux, *gateway.Deps)
Options Pipeline *proxy.Pipeline
Options PolicyTimeout time.Duration
Options Ready func(gateway.RunInfo)
Options Router extension.Router
Options Setup func(*gateway.Deps) error
Options Sink audit.AuditSink
Options Stderr io.Writer
Options Stdout io.Writer
Options Teardown func(*gateway.Deps)
Options WrapDataPlane func(http.Handler, *gateway.Deps) http.Handler

RequestStats Detectors []string
RequestStats Method string
RequestStats Path string
RequestStats Provider string
RequestStats Proxied bool
RequestStats Redactions int
RequestStats ReqBytes int
